title: [3.0.0.1] Buttons disappear when pump is disconnected
symptom: Since version 3.0.0.1, it is not possible to access the Insulin Dialog and BolusWizard when the pump is disconnected (via the disconnect buttons in the loop dialog). This prevents users from recording a bolus given while disconnected (e.g., when swimming) and makes the 'Do no bolus, record only' checkbox useless.
cause: The maintainer explains that the behavior is intentional: if the pump is not initialized (not known to AAPS), it's not possible to apply constraints from the pump, and it can be confusing to see the insulin dialog when the pump is disconnected.
evidence_quote: this settings was in AAPS all the time. The reason is very simple. If pump is not initialized (not known to AAPS) it's not possible apply constrains from pump.
